questions.question:
Arrange the following words in a logical and meaningful order.

1. World

2. Country

3. City

4. Continent

5. State
questions.solution:
The correct logical order is:

City → State → Country → Continent → World

Hence, ‘3, 5, 2, 4, 1’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that will fill in the blank and complete the given series

100, 99, 96, 91, 84, 75, 64, __________
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

100 - 1 = 99

99 - 3 = 96

96 - 5 = 91

91 - 7 = 84

84 - 9 = 75

75 - 11 = 64

64 - 13 = **51**

Hence, 51 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

4 : 67 ∷ 8 : ________
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

4³ = 64; 64 + 3 = 67

Similarly,

8³ = 512; 512 + 3 = 515.

Hence, 515 is the correct answer.

C + 4 → G; D + 4 → H; F + 4 → J

Similarly

K + 4 → O; L + 4 → P; N + 4 → R

Hence, ‘OPR’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: The minimum number of colours required to paint all the sides of a cube so that no two adjacent faces may have the same colours is:
questions.solution:
There are total 6 faces of a cube. If we paint opposite faces with same colour, then we will need a minimum of 3 colours so that no two adjacent faces have the same colour.

Hence, 3 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to he third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term.

961 : 992 ∷ 841 : __________.
questions.solution:
sqrt{961} = 31; 961 + 31 = 992 .

Similarly,

√841 = 29; 841 + 29 = 870.

Hence, 870 is the correct answer.

questions.question: Diabetes is related to Insulin in the same way as Anaemia is related to ________.
questions.solution:
A type of diabetes is caused by deficiency of insulin.

Similarly, a type of anaemia is caused by deficiency of iron.

Hence, ‘iron’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the word-pair in which the two words are related in the same way as the two words in the following word-pair.

China : Beijing : _______ : _______
questions.solution:
Beijing is the capital of China.

Similarly, Baghdad is the capital of Iraq.

Hence, ‘Iraq : Baghdad’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that will fill in the blank and complete the given series.

162, 180, 198, 216, 234, ________, 270, 288

A tailor had to cut a certain number of shirts from rolls of full-length fabrics. He cut each roll into 11 pieces of equal length. He cut the rolls of fabrics at a rate of 50 cut per minute. How many rolls of fabric would he be able to cut in 25 minutes?
questions.solution:
__**Note: To make 11 pieces of equal length from 1 full roll, we need to cut 10 times.**__

Rate of cutting = 50 cuts per minute.

Therefore, no. of cuts in 25 minutes = 50 × 25 = 1250.

⇒ No. of rolls cuts in 25 minutes

= No. of cuts in 25 minutes ÷ No. of cuts required for 1 roll

= 1250 ÷ 10

= 125.

questions.question: Three of the following four number-pairs are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick the odd pair out.
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

18 × 5 = 90

30 × 5 = 150

12 × 5 = 60

But

**25 × 4 = 100.**

Hence, ‘100, 25’ is the odd pair.

questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some rabbits are ducks.

Some ducks are dogs.

No dog is a horse.

**Conclusions:**

I. No horse is a duck.

II. No dog is a rabbit.

III. Some ducks are rabbits.

options.text: All conclusions I, II and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/204ee51ea73a24dfadee0e2834e05cb4f1e7b8d351b29718730c2a9fae20a838.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. No horse is a duck. → False (it is possible but not definite)

II. No dog is a rabbit. → False (it is possible but not definite)

III. Some ducks are rabbits. → True (some rabbits are ducks)

Hence, only conclusion III follows.

questions.question: Three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick the odd one out.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/deae6878e9b98a909a4f867d020ef0bc18c6460722a2de92ac9a1d324b3b29ec.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

E + 2 → G; G + 2 → I; I + 2 → K

S + 2 → U; U + 2 → W; W + 2 → Y

**L + 2 → N; N + 2 → P; P + 1 → Q**

P + 2 → R; R + 2 → T; T + 2 → V

Hence, ‘LNPQ’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: Introducing Kumar, Vikram said, "His mother is the wife of my father's son. I have no brother and sister." How is Kumar related to Vikram?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f9d1259d87f477eda38aa6063c751deade2cf9668ab857de428d70077af56cf.png] 

Using the above symbols, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/737d363b08265a30e3092b84c403bdfebd73704a8d8d7dc0b4f08a830530f091.png] 

Vikram has no brother or sister.

Therefore, Vikram’s father’s son is Vikram.

Now, mother of Kumar is the wife of Vikram.

Hence, Kumar is the son of Vikram.
